description: A plan ends when all tasks are done, the ADR is closed, and everything is on main.

specs.description: `hexa finish` lists open work with commands to close each item.
specs.given: A repository with uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, open tasks, unmerged worktree branches, merged clean worktrees, and unplanned drafts.
specs.then: It lists each item with the command to close it.

specs.description: Nothing open is reported as nothing open
specs.given: A repository with no open work.
specs.then: It prints `nothing open: the work is on main` and exits 0.

specs.description: `hexa finish --exit-code` exits 1 when anything is open.
specs.then: It exits 1 if any work is open, 0 otherwise.

specs.description: `hexa loop adr` appends `Land on main` and `Close <ADR>` to the checklist.
specs.given: A loop with a checklist of two tasks and no ADR recorded
specs.then: The checklist has `Land on main` and `Close <ADR>` as the last two items.

specs.description: `hexa loop adr` does not append the close-out steps twice.
specs.given: A loop where `Land on main` and `Close <ADR>` are already on the checklist.

specs.description: Tasks added after the close-out steps go before them.
specs.given: A loop with `Land on main` and `Close <ADR>` on the checklist.
specs.then: The new task is inserted before `Land on main`.

specs.description: `hexa loop stage done` is refused when work is open.
specs.given: A loop with open tasks or unmerged branches.
specs.then: It is refused with the open items named.

specs.description: `hexa loop stage done` closes out landed work
specs.given: A loop with all tasks done and all branches merged to main.
specs.then: It runs the gate on main, appends the evidence, sets the ADR to Completed with the reason `landed on main at <sha>; gate <command> passed`, and checks off `Close <ADR>`

specs.description: `hexa loop stage done` always checks the tree, not just the boxes.
specs.then: It sets the ADR to Completed only when `hexa finish` has nothing open for this work but the ADR; otherwise the ADR's status is unchanged

specs.description: `hexa do gate` lands a commit on main by fast-forwarding.
specs.given: A branch with a commit not on main, and a clean main.
specs.when: `hexa do gate` is run on the branch.
specs.then: The commit is fast-forwarded to main.

specs.description: `hexa do gate` refuses to land when main is dirty.
specs.given: A branch with a commit not on main, and a dirty main checkout.
specs.when: `hexa do gate` is run on the branch.
specs.then: The commit stays on the branch, and the reason is reported.

specs.description: Landing never pushes and never forces
specs.then: `origin` is unchanged by it, and main only ever moves by fast-forward

specs.description: The Stop hook blocks when a session has open work.
specs.given: A session with uncommitted changes or open tasks.
specs.then: It returns `block` with the open work listed.

specs.description: The Stop hook lets a session stop after three blocks.
specs.given: A session that has been blocked three times in a row.
specs.then: It lets the stop through and prints the open work.

specs.description: The Stop hook never blocks on unpushed commits.
specs.then: It does not block, but lists the unpushed commits in the reason.

specs.description: A plan is made when someone asks for one
specs.given: A person runs `hexa plan draft "<what is left>"`
specs.then: One draft workplan is written from that prompt

specs.description: A prompt is never drafted into a plan on its own
specs.given: A project that has not opted into auto-invoke, a long prompt, and a subagent brief
specs.when: Each goes through the hook router
specs.then: No draft workplan is written for either

specs.description: A plan is made only when someone asks for one.
specs.then: It drafts a workplan only for a project that opted into auto-invoke, and never from a subagent brief
